//: Cypress ships its own global `expect` from Chai. While its specs were part of the root tsconfig program, that global shadowed Jest's `expect` across the whole repo — every colocated *.test.ts failed with 'Property toEqual does not exist on type Assertion. Did you mean equal?' (356 errors). The root tsconfig now excludes cypress/; this keeps these specs typechecked on their own terms. `exclude` must be restated because the inherited one excludes this very directory.
